Entrezgene.Entrezgene_summary: Predicted to enable inward rectifier potassium channel activity. Predicted to be involved in several processes, including membrane repolarization during cardiac muscle cell action potential; regulation of heart rate by cardiac conduction; and regulation of ventricular cardiac muscle cell membrane repolarization. Predicted to be active in plasma membrane. Is expressed in several structures, including digestive system; fin; gill; heart; and immune system. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in long QT syndrome; long QT syndrome 2; and short QT syndrome. Orthologous to human KCNH2 (potassium voltage-gated channel subfamily H member 2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]
